capabilities: Move a heading and all its content past sibling sections
Indent and unindent headings with Tab and Shift+Tab
Fold and unfold the outline progressively by level
Visually indent headings per level in editor and reading view
disambiguation: Not a bullet-list outliner; it applies outliner keys only on heading lines and passes other keypresses through to list editors.
extras: Hotkeys are handled via CodeMirror 6 keymaps and are not exposed to Obsidian's hotkey manager; custom modifier configuration is planned. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Works seamlessly with Obsidian's built-in fold commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move or re-indent entire heading sections, and Tab/Shift+Tab only work on list lines, not headings.

relations.evidence: Fully compatible with the Outliner plugin.

summary: Outliner-style editing for heading-based Markdown: move, indent, and fold whole sections with keyboard shortcuts.
